tool_activity.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files -g 'TASK.md' -g 'materials/**' -g 'candidate.py' -g '"'!__pycache__'"' && printf '%s\\n' '--- TASK.md ---' && sed -n '1,240p' TASK.md"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- arg_reduce references ---' && rg -n -C 5 'arg_reduce|rank-zero|rank 0|scalar|runtime scalar|Out\\[' materials/dsl materials/programming-model TASK.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- existing candidate ---' && sed -n '1,220p' candidate.py && printf '%s\\n' '--- all material files ---' && rg --files materials"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,220p' materials/dsl/types-numerics-and-effects.md && sed -n '220,420p' materials/dsl/types-numerics-and-effects.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- docs mentioning annotation shapes ---' && rg -n -C 3 'I\\.(In|Out|InOut)|runtime scalar|scalar parameter|ranked tensor|rank-zero|shape=' materials -g '*.md' -g '*.py'"
/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- accessible task context file ---' && file /home/kingdom/.codex/tmp/arg0 && sed -n '1,240p' /home/kingdom/.codex/tmp/arg0"
